description_lines: A demo project used to pin the status card model.
status_model.name: demo

stub:
# ghtools-stub: 1 — generated by `ghtools init`; settings live in .github/ghtools.toml
name: ghtools
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: Compute the release without writing anything
        type: boolean
        default: true
permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write
concurrency:
  group: ghtools-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  pipeline:
    uses: will-roscoe/.ghtools/.github/workflows/pipeline.yml@v1
    with:
      dry-run: ${{ inputs.dry-run || false }}
    secrets:
      CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
  # PyPI only accepts uploads from a workflow file in this repository, so this job lives here.
  publish-pypi:
    needs: pipeline
    if: needs.pipeline.outputs.released == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: pypi
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.pipeline.outputs.dist-artifact }}
          path: dist
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@dc37677b2e1c63e2034f94d8a5b11f265b73ba33 # v1.14.2
